subject.title: Channel setup vocabulary leaks into core (ChannelSetupInput, channels add flags, promotion keys)

question: Should the three-part channel-setup ownership program remain coordinated by this issue after Part 1, with maintainer-sponsored follow-up work for promotion keys and the SDK type boundary?
rationale: The report proposes a cross-plugin architecture migration and an SDK-facing type change; the linked PR intentionally implements only one part, so maintainers must choose the desired sequencing and acceptance boundary.

options.title: Keep this as the umbrella
options.body: Land the narrow flag/parsing repair first, then use this issue to coordinate the promotion-key and type-ownership follow-ups.

options.title: Narrow to the packaged-install bug
options.body: Treat the linked PR as the complete fix for user-facing flag registration and track the broader ownership refactors separately.

recommendation.title: Keep this as the umbrella
recommendation.body: Land the narrow flag/parsing repair first, then use this issue to coordinate the promotion-key and type-ownership follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored both the program definition and the linked Part 1 implementation, so they are the clearest available owner for sequencing intent.
